chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah said:

I asked him about a man who married a young girl or enjoyed her (temporary marriage), then she made the dowry from her side permissible (for him to keep) so that it was permissible for him to have intercourse with her before giving her anything. He said, 'Yes, if she made it permissible, then she has taken possession of it from him. And if he left her before having intercourse with her, the woman returns to the man half of the dowry.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on returning half the dowry if a husband has intercourse before full payment and then leaves the wife?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Samaanah clarifies the legal status of the dowry (*mahr*) when a wife grants her husband permission (*ijaz*) to consummate the marriage before full payment. The ruling distinguishes between the immediate transfer of ownership upon permission and the specific obligation to return half the dowry if the husband leaves her before actual physical consummation, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on the distinction between *ijaz* and *dakhil*. This principle underscores the equitable distribution of marital rights and financial obligations in early Islamic jurisprudence.
